name: Wallet Ready Gift Cards for WooCommerce by GiftRocketWP
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
GiftRocketWP is a complete WooCommerce gift card solution for online stores to sell, send, and manage digital gift cards.

Create gift cards with preset or custom amounts, personalized messages, scheduled delivery, professional PDF cards, QR codes, barcodes, PDF417, and digital wallet support.

Customers can receive gift cards by email, redeem them through WooCommerce Cart and Checkout, and check their gift card balance and transaction history.

GiftRocketWP also supports WooCommerce Blocks, HPOS, CSV migration, multilingual stores, and modern gift card management tools.

Live Demo | Documentation | Get GiftRocketWP Pro

Why WooCommerce store owners choose GiftRocketWP

  • Sell digital gift cards — Create dedicated gift card products with preset or custom amounts, recipient details, and personalized messages.
  • Create professional PDF gift cards — Generate downloadable or email PDF cards with custom designs, barcodes, and QR codes linking to redemption or direct Apple/Google Wallet passes.
  • Offer Apple Wallet & Google Wallet — Provide mobile wallet passes via ePasscard with automatic delivery sync and background retry recovery.
  • Schedule gift card delivery — Let customers choose when a gift card should be delivered to the recipient.
  • Redeem like store credit — Customers can apply gift card codes on Cart and Checkout (with independent display controls for each page) while unused balances remain available for later purchases.
  • Track balances and transactions — Customers can check gift card balance, status, expiry, wallet passes, and transaction history.
  • Manage gift cards from one dashboard — Search, filter, issue, edit, and manage gift cards from the WordPress admin.
  • Built for modern WooCommerce — Supports WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks, HPOS, classic shortcodes, and REST API features.
  • Import existing gift cards — Migrate gift card codes and balances from CSV files.
  • Multilingual and RTL ready — Compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, Polylang, and RTL languages.

Configure GiftRocketWP from GiftRocketWP → Gift Cards with dedicated settings for general options, gift card forms, PDF/email design, delivery, and wallet integration.

Create and sell WordPress gift cards

GiftRocketWP includes everything you need to start selling digital gift cards in WooCommerce.

  • Dedicated Gift Card product type
  • Preset amounts and custom amounts with minimum and maximum limits
  • Recipient name and email
  • Sender name and personalized greeting/message
  • Custom field labels and message length controls
  • Gift card design gallery with image backgrounds and solid and gradient layouts
  • Live gift card preview
  • Scheduled email delivery with date and time selection
  • Automatic scheduled delivery processing
  • PDF gift cards included in the free plugin
  • PDF customization with layouts, colors, typography, and styling controls
  • Optional QR code, barcode, and PDF417 with direct Wallet Pass QR links
  • Optional Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes with automatic retry and delivery sync
  • Redeem gift card codes on Cart and Checkout
  • Show or hide the gift card code field separately on Cart and Checkout (Classic and Blocks)
  • Support for both classic WooCommerce and Cart/Checkout Blocks
  • Edit gift card details from the Cart when enabled
  • Apply gift cards to admin-created or edited orders
  • Purchaser My Account → Gift Cards
  • PDF download and wallet pass links from My Account when available
  • Per-product gift card expiry options
  • Optional checkout recipient flow using billing/shipping information
  • Multiple gift cards from one product page
  • Quantity limits per add-to-cart
  • Custom add-to-cart and shop loop button text
  • CSV import and migration
  • Fraud protection with rate limits and security logging
  • System status and feature overview
  • WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang compatibility
  • RTL support and translation-ready strings

PDF gift cards

Create professional, printable gift card PDFs that customers can download or receive by email.

  • Custom PDF layouts, colors, and typography
  • Gift card recipient, sender details, and formatted multi-line gift messages
  • Gift card code and balance information
  • Wallet Pass QR code — direct link for recipients to save cards to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet
  • Redemption QR code — instant scan to redeem and apply the gift card in cart
  • Barcode and PDF417 codes
  • Custom styling options
  • Instant PDF delivery by email and downloadable PDF from customer My Account

Apple Wallet & Google Wallet integration

Give customers a modern, mobile-first experience by letting them save gift cards directly into Apple Wallet and Google Wallet.

GiftRocketWP supports optional digital wallet passes through ePasscard (free for up to 50 live passes, then paid) or the GiftToWallet add-on, with built-in reliability features:

  • Delivery synchronization — Gift card emails and SMS wait until the Apple or Google Wallet pass is generated before sending, ensuring recipients receive complete pass links.
  • Automatic background pass recovery — If external pass creation fails at initial issuance, GiftRocketWP automatically retries up to 3 times (5 minutes apart).
  • Direct Wallet Pass QR Code on PDF — Recipients can scan the QR code printed on their PDF gift card to immediately add the pass to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
  • Instant access — Recipients can view and save passes from their gift card email or customer My Account area.

Learn more about ePasscard

Gift card balance and redemption

GiftRocketWP manages gift cards as a reusable balance instead of a one-time coupon.

  • Flexible redemption placement — Choose whether to show or hide the “Have a gift card code?” field on the Cart page, Checkout page, or both.
  • Full compatibility with WooCommerce Blocks — Seamless redemption support on classic templates and modern Cart/Checkout Blocks.
  • One-click QR code redemption — Scanning the gift card QR code automatically applies the card to the cart even when manual entry is hidden.
  • Reusable balance and store credit — Unused gift card funds remain securely available for future purchases.
  • Balance and transaction history — Customers can check their balance, expiry date, and transaction history in My Account.
  • Central admin dashboard — Store owners can issue gift cards, view balances, check audit logs, and manage cards with ease.

GiftRocketWP Pro

GiftRocketWP Pro adds advanced tools for stores that need more control over gift cards, redemption, reporting, and automation.

Install the free GiftRocketWP plugin first, then install and activate GiftRocketWP Pro.

Pro features include:

  • Bonus value promotions (“Pay X, get Y”) — Boost sales with promotional bonus value on gift card purchases and balance top-ups (e.g., “Pay $50, get $55” or “Top up $100, get $10 extra”). Gift card tiers can be a percentage or a fixed amount; top-up tiers are fixed amounts.
  • SMS gift card delivery via Twilio — Let buyers deliver gift cards via SMS, email, or both directly to the recipient’s mobile phone.
  • Gift card balance top-up — Let customers recharge existing gift cards using dedicated top-up products or the [wallregi_topup] shortcode.
  • Checkout gift card editing — Edit gift card details at checkout using supported checkout methods.
  • Advanced balance and transaction lookup — Display gift card balance and transaction history with [wallregi_transactions].
  • Greeting message presets — Offer predefined greeting options for customers.
  • Partial redemption — Choose how much of a gift card balance to apply to an order.
  • Advanced order rules — Configure gift card limits and combined redemption rules.
  • Large CSV migration — Import up to 5,000 gift cards per file.
  • Liability reporting — Export outstanding gift card balances for accounting and reporting.
  • Expiry reminder emails — Automatically remind customers about upcoming gift card expiry dates.
  • WooCommerce REST API — Look up gift cards and transactions through supported REST API endpoints.
  • AI writing assistant — Generate staff copy and customer greetings using your own API key with supported AI providers.

Explore GiftRocketWP Pro

Give your customers the gift of choice this spooky season. Turn Halloween gifting into a delightful shopping experience with personalized WooCommerce gift cards that are easy to create, purchase, and share.

WooCommerce compatibility

GiftRocketWP is built specifically for WooCommerce.

  • Requires WooCommerce
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks
  • Compatible with classic WooCommerce Cart and Checkout
  • Compatible with High Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Guest-friendly gift card redemption
  • Gift cards are not locked to a single customer account
  • PHP 8.1+
  • Compatible with WPML
  • Compatible with Loco Translate
  • Compatible with Polylang
  • RTL-ready

Import and migration

Already have gift cards in another system?

Use GiftRocketWP → Import / Migrate (CSV) to migrate existing gift card codes and balances.

Free: up to 500 rows per file.

Pro: up to 5,000 rows per file.

This makes GiftRocketWP suitable for stores moving from another gift card system.

External services

GiftRocketWP can optionally connect to external services for specific features.

  • dompdf — bundled with GiftRocketWP and used to generate PDF gift cards on your server. Learn more
  • ePasscard — optional service used to generate Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. Requires your own API key. Learn more
  • Twilio — optional Pro feature used to send gift card links via SMS. Requires your own Twilio account and credentials. Learn more
  • AI providers — optional Pro feature. Supported providers include OpenAI, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, and Anthropic. Your own API key is required.

Translations

GiftRocketWP is translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang.

For site owners

  1. Set Settings → General → Site Language.
  2. Use WPML, Loco Translate, Poedit, or translation files from the languages/ directory.
  3. Sample locales include Bengali (bn_BD) and Spanish (es_ES).

WordPress.org language packs

Community translations can be provided through translate.wordpress.org.

Until a language pack is available for your locale, use WPML, Loco Translate, Poedit, or the bundled translation files.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate GiftRocketWP from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Go to GiftRocketWP → Gift Cards.
  4. Review the General, Form, PDF/Email, Delivery, and Wallet settings.
  5. Go to Products → Add New.
  6. Select Gift Card from the Product data dropdown.
  7. Configure the gift card amount, recipient fields, design, delivery, and other options.
  8. Publish the product and start selling gift cards.

Optional:

Install GiftRocketWP Pro for advanced gift card management, reporting, expiry reminders, partial redemption, larger CSV imports, REST API tools, and AI features.
sections.faq:
Does GiftRocketWP require WooCommerce?

Yes. GiftRocketWP is built for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I sell digital gift cards, gift certificates, or gift vouchers?

Yes. GiftRocketWP lets you create Gift Card products with preset or custom amounts. Customers can send gift cards by email and optionally provide PDF or wallet versions.

Can I create PDF gift cards?

Yes. PDF gift cards are included in the free plugin. You can customize the PDF design and optionally add QR codes, barcodes, and PDF417.

Can customers schedule gift card delivery?

Yes. Customers can choose a future delivery date and time when scheduling is enabled. GiftRocketWP processes scheduled deliveries automatically in the background.

Does GiftRocketWP support Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?

Yes. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes are available through the optional ePasscard integration. Your own ePasscard API key is required.

How do customers redeem gift cards?

Customers enter their gift card code on the WooCommerce Cart or Checkout. Remaining balances can be used for future purchases according to your gift card settings.

Can customers use part of a gift card balance?

Yes. GiftRocketWP supports reusable gift card balances. Partial redemption controls are available in GiftRocketWP Pro.

Does GiftRocketWP work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. Gift card redemption is supported on WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks. Additional checkout editing features are available in Pro.

Is GiftRocketWP compatible with HPOS?

Yes. GiftRocketWP supports WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I import existing gift cards?

Yes. Use GiftRocketWP → Import / Migrate (CSV).

The free version supports up to 500 rows per file. GiftRocketWP Pro supports up to 5,000 rows per file.

Can I create and manage gift cards from the WordPress admin?

Yes. The GiftRocketWP dashboard lets store owners search, filter, issue, edit, and manage gift cards and their balances.

Can customers check their gift card balance?

Yes. Use the [wallregi_transactions] shortcode to display gift card balance and transaction history on any WordPress page.

Can buyers edit gift card information after adding it to the Cart?

Yes. Cart editing is available in the free plugin when enabled. Additional Checkout editing features are available in GiftRocketWP Pro.

Is GiftRocketWP compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang?

Yes. GiftRocketWP is translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang. The plugin uses standard WordPress gettext methods and includes RTL support.

Does GiftRocketWP include AI features?

AI writing assistance is available in GiftRocketWP Pro. Store owners provide their own API key for supported AI providers.

How is a GiftRocketWP gift card different from a WooCommerce coupon?

GiftRocketWP gift cards use a reusable balance system. Customers can spend part of the balance, keep the remaining balance, and view their transaction history. WooCommerce coupons use a different discount system.

Can I hide the gift card code field on the Cart or Checkout page?

Yes. Navigate to GiftRocketWP → Settings → General Settings → Essential options. You can independently enable or disable the “Gift card field on cart page” and “Gift card field on checkout page”. This works for both classic WooCommerce and WooCommerce Cart/Checkout Blocks. If the field is hidden, customers can still redeem cards via QR code links or PDF links.

How does the Apple Wallet and Google Wallet pass delivery work?

When Apple Wallet or Google Wallet pass generation is enabled via ePasscard or GiftToWallet, GiftRocketWP automatically synchronizes delivery. The plugin waits until the digital pass is generated before sending the gift card notification email or SMS, so the recipient never receives an incomplete email. If pass creation fails, GiftRocketWP retries automatically up to 3 times, 5 minutes apart. You can also display a QR code on the PDF gift card that takes recipients straight to their wallet pass.

Can gift cards be delivered via SMS?

Yes. SMS delivery is supported in GiftRocketWP Pro using Twilio. Customers can choose to send the gift card by email, SMS, or both during purchase.

Can I offer bonus value or promotional tiers on gift cards and reloads?

Yes. GiftRocketWP Pro includes a Bonus Value (“Pay X, get Y”) feature for both gift card products and top-up reloads (for example, “Pay $50, get $55” or “Top up $100, get $10 extra”). Gift card tiers can be a percentage or a fixed amount, with optional start and end dates; top-up tiers are fixed amounts.

1.1.4 (October 23, 2026)

  • New: Option to show or hide the gift card code field separately on Cart and Checkout pages (Classic and Blocks).
  • New: Delivery synchronization — gift card email and SMS wait until Apple/Google Wallet pass is generated before sending.
  • New: Automatic background retry (up to 3 times) for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet pass generation.
  • New: PDF gift card QR code options to link directly to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes.
  • New: Developer hook wallregi_issue_giftcard_bonus_amount for issuance bonus value.
  • Fix: Prevented fatal error when WooCommerce is inactive, adding an informative setup screen.
  • Fix: Fixed “Send now” instant delivery delays caused by site date-format parsing.
  • Fix: Preserved line breaks and formatting for personalized gift card messages across previews, PDFs, and emails.
  • Fix: Clearer ePasscard error messages in the wallet settings.

1.1.3 (October 7, 2026)

  • Fix: Gift card amounts now follow WooCommerce’s “Number of decimals” setting everywhere (purchase, cart edit, checkout, admin, bulk import). A $25.75 gift card stays $25.75 instead of becoming $26 or $25. Existing data is upgraded automatically.
  • Fix: Checkout deductions with cents are stored exactly (balances were rounded to whole numbers).
  • Fix: Gift card products can no longer be added to the cart without the gift card form (direct ?add-to-cart links, Store API).
  • New: “Restore to gift card” on paid orders, to give back part of the gift card payment for partial refunds.
  • New: After a failed payment the gift card amount stays reserved for a configurable number of hours (default 24) so the customer can retry. If the order is still unpaid then, it is cancelled and the amount goes back to the card.
  • Fix: Bundled translations (Arabic, Spanish) now load.
  • Fix: PHP warning on the dashboard when a gift card has no expiry period.
  • Fix: The gift card balance change is undone if its transaction history row can’t be saved.
  • Fix: Custom gift card amounts with decimals are read correctly on stores that use “.” as thousands separator (30,50 was added to the cart as 3.050,00).
  • Fix: Preset gift card amounts with decimals are read correctly in the product form.
  • Fix: Admin gift card create/edit and the cart edit popups (classic and block cart) accept amounts with decimals.
  • Fix: Gift card products without the gift card form data are removed from the cart with a notice.

1.1.2 (September 25, 2026)

  • New: Redesigned Bulk Import page with a cleaner modern look.
  • New: Redesigned Outstanding Balance & Liability Exports page for better usability.
  • New: Added dedicated calendar confirmation button for the ‘Send At’ datepicker.
  • New: Added helper notice description below the ‘Send At’ field.
  • Fix: Fixed custom PDF layout panel toggle AJAX show/hide issue on product edit screens.
  • Fix: Fixed translation issue for ‘Send At’ calendar and datepicker texts.
  • Update: Made all text translatable on the Import and Balance Export pages.

  • New: Full compatibility with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang with localized JavaScript validation strings.
  • Update: Scheduled email delivery checks now run every 1 minute in the background.
  • Fix: Timezone display bug for scheduled deliveries in non-UTC site timezones.
